title_en: Table 12.2 : MONTHLY ELECTRICITY PRODUCTION BY PUBLIC SECTOR, 2023
source: Source: State Electric Company Limited, Fenaka Corporation Limited
notes: Note: 2023 Monthly Electricity Production includes Fuel, Lub oil and monthly total generation which includes renewable energy STELCO PV, Power purchase agreement PV and Net Metering data respectively
PV - Photovoltaic system is an electrical system that produces energy from a renewable and inexhaustible source the sun.

Net metering: Net metering is a billing tool offered for customers with on-site solar panels which can send the excess energy generated by their renewable energy systems back to the STELCO electric grid which is then credited from there energy bills.

PPA: Solar power purchase agreement (solar PPA), you contract with a solar developer that pays for, installs, and maintains a solar system on your property. The developer owns the system but agrees to sell you electricity at a fixed price.
